description: This file initializes and exports a singleton Supabase client for use in a React frontend application. It reads configuration from environment variables, manages client instance caching to prevent multiple creations during development hot reloads, and provides a default export for easy access.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient()
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Supabase client, configured with environment variables, with caching to prevent multiple instances during hot reloads and development.
